Proof. Proof of axiom 4 (volume constraint) for QOU existence

Proof. Let V \in \mathbf{C} be the standard representation (dimension n = \dim V_{\mathrm{std}}). The top exterior power \Lambda^{n} V is the 1-dimensional trivial module, \Lambda^{n} V \cong \mathbf{1}, with isomorphism \epsilon \colon \Lambda^{n} V \to \mathbf{1} given by the q-deformed determinant (the quantum volume form) [kassel1995]. By G-invariance of the determinant,

  \epsilon \circ \Lambda^{n}(g_{V})
  \;=\;
  g_{\mathbf{1}} \circ \epsilon
  \;=\; \epsilon
  \quad \text{for all } g \in \mathrm{Aut}^{\otimes}(\tau),

which is axiom~(4). \square
